An '''attack cruiser''' was a spacecraft used to transport soldiers or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during their missions.

==History==
One such cruiser, the ''[[Justice Crusader]]'', carried several Jedi to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] on a quest to kill the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]].
